title: Affine-local properness of finite type relative Proj
statement: Let S be a scheme, E a quasi-coherent finite-type O_S-module, and U an affine open of S. The restriction to U of the structural morphism of the canonical relative Proj of Sym(E) is proper.

proof.text: Use the affine finite-generator presentation on an affine open cover. The local relative Proj is H-projective and hence proper. Apply the canonical restriction comparison to identify it with the restricted global relative Proj, transport properness across the isomorphism, and use target-locality of properness. Finally restrict the resulting global proper morphism to the given affine open.

proof_origin.place: Lemmas 01WB and 01WC, affine-local comparison and local properness
